The '''Agrilat District''' was a district of the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[Chemical Refinement District]] was located in the Agrilat District, as was [[Coronet Boulevard]].
